value.title: spawn-reports-bind
value.summary: pij-rs spawn distinguishes dispatched from bound and surfaces a named failure with the child's last log lines when the pane dies before the seat binds.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: req-0035 (meadowlark 2026-09-02): pij-rs spawn --harness pi --bin omp returned ok:true; seat pij-cheerful-orlandine stayed idle/proc null and the pane was gone within ~2 min; nothing readable said why (no per-seat spawn log). Dispatch is not delivery. Also known: pij fires false terminal-absence notices on many omp spawns, and omp silently falls back to Opus 5 when its model call fails.

sections.name: goals
value: G1 spawn returns {dispatched:true, bound:false|true, pane, pid} and, unless --no-wait, waits up to N seconds for the seat to register (extension boot ping / /v1/register from that pane) and reports bound or a named failure.

G2 On a pane that exits before bind: capture the child exit code and the last 20 lines of its output (tmux capture-pane before the window is gone, or a pipe-pane log under ~/.pij-rs/spawn/<spawn_id>.log) and return them in the failure.
G3 A spine event spawn.bound / spawn.failed with the evidence so it is locatable by seat/spawn id later.
G4 Fix the false terminal-absence notice if it is the same code path; otherwise record it as a separate finding with file:line.
G5 A queued delivery for an unbound spawned seat whose pane is absent becomes terminal failed state naming the seat and pane; it is not retried.
G6 On the next drain tick, every pending delivery whose recipient is tombstoned or whose pane is absent from tmux list-panes -a becomes terminal failed state with a named reason and is never retried.
Ruling note: the original AC1 assumed an invalid OMP model exits. OMP v18 stays alive as no-model; AC1a and AC1b split model mismatch from real child-exit evidence.

G7 A refused spawn carries machine-readable details {dispatched, bound, pane, pid, reason}; pane absence is terminal only after successful inventory and an explicit socket-unreachable result, while unknowns retry visibly.

value.text: LIVE: a deliberately bad OMP model leaves the real client alive as no-model and spawn returns spawn.failed with the pane model warning and requested-versus-actual mismatch.
value.claim: bad OMP model reports the observed mismatch

value.text: LIVE: a normal omp spawn returns bound:true with the seat id within the wait window.
Unit RED-first: child exits 1 immediately → caller sees exit + log path, never ok:true.
RED-first unit: an unbound spawned seat whose pane disappeared leaves one named failed outcome, zero retries, and no live queue row.
value.claim: dead recipients terminalize queued delivery without retry

value.text: RED-first unit tests plus a dev daemon against a writable production-database copy show zero pending delivery rows to tombstoned or pane-absent recipients within one drain cadence; failed rows retain named reasons.
value.claim: all dead-recipient delivery rows terminalize next tick

value.text: LIVE: a real tmux child exit returns spawn.failed with exit code 23, stderr tail, durable log path, and spawn.failed spine evidence.
value.claim: child exit reports exit code and durable output evidence

value.text: A refused spawn carries an exact structured details object with dispatched, bound, pane, pid, and reason; the test parses fields rather than matching meta prose.
